title: Move Ownership to Thread
goal: Move a local variable into a thread closure and handle the join result.
hints: Spawned threads may outlive the function scope, so borrowed references are not allowed.
`JoinHandle::join` returns a Result, which must be unwrapped to retrieve the inner value.
explanation: Adding `move` forces the closure to take full ownership of `s`, satisfying the `'static` requirement for `thread::spawn`. Omitting `move` causes `E0373` because `s` is borrowed. `async` is invalid closure syntax here. `.join()` returns `Result<usize, Box<dyn Any>>`, so calling `.unwrap()` extracts the returned length `5`. Using `?` fails to compile (`E0277`) because `calculate_length` returns `usize`, not `Result`.
